mechanism: survival hazard of completed prior-UTC-day highs and lows under repeated causally separated interactions

level_contract.creation: high and low of a fully completed UTC day, usable from the next UTC day
level_contract.retirement: completed close at least 1.25 completed-state scales beyond the level
level_contract.cluster_deduplication: one closest same-side level per completed 15-minute interaction, newest level on ties
level_contract.scale: decision close times mean(high/low-1) over the latest 96 completed 15-minute bars, minimum 48

model.features: level touch history, prior rejection and penetration, approach compression and returns, completed price/volume/turnover, Bybit OI/account ratio/funding and completed BTC/ETH confirmation

execution.funding: exact signed Bybit settlements between entry and structural exit

survivor_gate.winner_removal: delete the top ceil(10%) positive selected event IDs and rerun the full global router
